name: JointAVBench
intro: JointAVBench 是一个严格要求联合音视频推理的选择题基准。它从 SF20K 的 1,046 部可用专业短片生成场景级视觉与四类音频描述，覆盖 5 个认知维度、4 类音频、3 类场景跨度和 15 个任务。自动流程生成的 3,974 道题经专业人工复核和答案标签复审后保留 2,853 道题。
org: Renmin University of China, Baichuan Inc., Zhongguancun Academy
build_method: 半自动生成, 人工复核, 标签审计
modality: 音频, 视频, 文本
task_type: 联合音视频推理, 选择题
eval_feature: 严格多模态依赖, 跨场景推理
build_method_en: Semi-automated Generation, Human Verification, Label Audit
intro_en: JointAVBench is a multiple-choice benchmark that strictly requires joint audio-visual reasoning. From 1,046 usable professional films in SF20K, it generates scene-level visual and four-type audio captions spanning five cognitive dimensions, four audio types, three scene spans, and 15 tasks. Professional human verification and a post-audit retain 2,853 of 3,974 automatically generated MCQs.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.12772v2 Sections 3–4 and Appendices A–B plus official repository snapshot dbd84e1. The diagram follows SF20K filtering, scene segmentation, separate visual/audio captions, strict-correlation QA generation, general/specific checks, three distractors, 3,974 candidates, professional human verification, post-audit label refinement, and the final 2,853-question accuracy evaluation.
